anchor_comparisons: Both cross-sector anchors sit near their component ceiling, but they are low-confidence ordinal comparisons and cannot transfer their numeric bands to this memory commercialization case.
The positive anchor resembles execution-led rerating, while the counter anchor warns that proxy valuation narratives can overstate rerating without durable economics.
disagreements: I give more weight to verified commercialization than to the view that all recovery expectations are already reflected, but I do not treat peer gaps as automatically closable.
payload.rationale: Stable HBM4 yields, final SiP performance, mass production for a named platform, continued customer deliveries, and one-billion-dollar cumulative revenue show a progression from qualification to commercialization. Lower forward peer multiples and relative underperformance add rerating capacity, but already-higher PBR and uncertain product margin and allocation limit the upper range.
payload.why_not_higher: Customer-level volume, price, margin, and durable share are undisclosed; initial profitability, shipment delay, supplier review, and prior PBR expansion limit further rerating.
payload.why_not_lower: A lower placement would underweight the complete yield-to-production-to-delivery-to-revenue sequence and remaining forward-multiple discount.
